result.stdout:
dotnet-bpa - C# best-practice analyzer

USAGE:
  dotnet-bpa analyze <path> [options]

ARGUMENTS:
  <path>            A .cs file or a directory to analyze recursively.

OPTIONS:
  --sarif <file>    Also write results to a SARIF v2.1.0 file.
  --ai              Run an optional AI-assisted review (requires
                    ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable).
  -h, --help        Show this help.

EXIT CODES:
  0   No error-severity issues.
  1   One or more error-severity issues found.
  64  Usage error.
  66  Input path not found.

EXAMPLES:
  dotnet-bpa analyze ./src
  dotnet-bpa analyze ./MyService.cs --sarif results.sarif
  dotnet-bpa analyze ./src --ai
